title: Headless C++ test harness for pure modules (cl.exe, no UE)
acceptance_criteria: tools/test_headless.ps1 locates vcvars64 via vswhere, compiles all Tests/Headless/**/*.cpp plus pure sources of CodexCore and CodexVehicleDynamics except *Module.cpp with cl /std:c++20 /fp:precise /W4 /WX /permissive- /GR-, runs the binary, prints wall time and exits with its code.
No UE path appears on the compile line.
Exits non-zero when run with -SelfTestFail (a deliberately failing test).
Full build and run under 30 s on the dev machine (measured).
